doc.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002

chapter: First road work and his father
title: His father's death and the German bow
summary: His father died after a gig in 1965 having seen his success; they discuss Slam Stewart and the German bow his father taught him.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: But he was able to pass away while on the bandstand, I mean while on the gig. It was right after the gig one night, he was up in Schenectady, New York, where — by the way — his favorite bassist—
Slam Stewart lived, or was born. I think it was Schenectady, New York wasn’t it?
Yes. Okay. That’s interesting. And I see when you’re doing Slam Stewart you’re doing the German bow. Is that what they call it?
Yes. That’s what my father taught me, the German bow.
That’s great that he was able to see your success well underway.
